---
title: "Write and export your report"
---


Copy `templates/learner-report.qmd` to the repository root as `my-study-report.qmd`. Fill in the prompts and select the output folder for your dataset.

Update all image paths to that output folder. Render the report from the root:

```bash
quarto render my-study-report.qmd --to html
```

Check that images load and every numerical statement agrees with its table. Save `session-info.txt` alongside the report and record the input source, selection decisions, and AI assistance.
